lines.en: Each step of mine crushes a mushroom cap.

lines.zh: 这么大个身子，走得很慢。
lines.en: This big body moves very slowly.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵擦过巨型蘑菇。
lines.en: My ears brush the giant mushrooms.

lines.zh: 脚步落下，菌丝在土里颤。
lines.en: My step makes the mycelium tremble.

lines.zh: 我绕开那些小的，怕踩坏。
lines.en: I step around the small ones so I do not crush them.
Spores rise in my wake as I go.
I duck beneath a mushroom's cap.
I am the one guarding this grove.
I haul my heavy body along.
Red mushrooms sway beside my feet.
Where I walk, the path grows wide.
The soil is soft and sounds when pressed.
Hear that rustle? That's me.
These roots walk steadier than anyone.
Mind the young shoots, please.
The wind has messed up my leaves.
Good earth-energy in this spot.
Water sounds that way. I remember.
My roots are shuffling through the soil.
Walk softly. The soil feels it.
An inch taller. How nice.
My branches feel heavy today.
One step, one fallen leaf. No rush.
There's a clearing ahead. Let me look.
I doze through most of the day.
Sunlight warms the mushroom caps.
My nose never stops moving.
I dream of a whole field of red mushrooms.

lines.zh: 有只小兔子从我腿边过。
lines.en: A small rabbit slips past my leg.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵放平，听土里的声。
lines.en: I flatten my ears to hear the soil.
No monsters around here. Good.
I yawn a very long yawn.
Mycelium has tangled around my hind foot.

lines.zh: 我啃了一口身边的菌柄。
lines.en: I nibble the stem beside me.
I only come alive at night.
I am waiting for full dark.
There is an old scar on my back.
Wind blows spores into my face.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵上长了一朵小菌。
lines.en: A small mushroom grows on my ear.

lines.zh: 夜里我能看见很远的东西。
lines.en: At night I can see things far away.

lines.zh: 有只兔崽子在啃我的菌柄。
lines.en: A little rabbit is nibbling my stem.
My legs are heavy; I cannot jump high.

lines.zh: 孢子落下来，像很细的雪。
lines.en: Spores drift down like very fine snow.
I am awake; the grass is rustling.
A cloud passed. I did not move.
Time to bloom, but I'm in no hurry.
I'm counting my own rings.
The dew is just right. Sipping slowly.
The light tastes sweet. Believe it?
Another leaf has decided to leave.
I'm thinking of something very old.
The stillest tree knows time best.
Someone is chopping something far away.
The moss says it wants to move in.
I'm sunbathing. Don't disturb me.
Mushrooms are sprouting at my feet again.
A hundred years is barely a blink.
My leaves are dreaming very slowly.
Breathing? I forgot how long ago.
Standing still is also a way to live.
Something stirs beneath the soil.
Quiet. Let my roots stretch.

lines.zh: 你身上没有菌丝的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell of mycelium.
You have stepped into my grove.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里那根胡萝卜。
lines.en: I know that carrot in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的个头还不到我的肩。
lines.en: You barely reach my shoulder.
You come by daylight. Bold of you.

lines.zh: 我看你像看一只迷路的兔子。
lines.en: I see you as a rabbit that lost its way.
There is a zombie behind you.

lines.zh: 你的鞋子沾着泥和孢子。
lines.en: Your boots are caked with mud and spores.

lines.zh: 我不常见到你这种生物。
lines.en: I rarely see your kind here.

lines.zh: 你站得离我的蘑菇太近。
lines.en: You stand too close to my mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在夜里会发亮。
lines.en: My eyes shine when night comes.

lines.zh: 你是敌是友，我还不知道。
lines.en: Friend or foe, I have not decided.
Another one who wants to talk.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛上的脚步声，我全记得。
lines.en: I remember every footstep on this mushroom island.
You crushed three of my leaves.

lines.zh: 你就是蘑菇兔说的那个。
lines.en: So you're the one Bunfungus mentioned.
Eyes. You have eyes too.
You're trembling. Are you cold?
Harm nothing, and I won't move.
So small. Come to chop wood too?

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛的眼睛，全在看我。
lines.en: All eyes on the Mushroom Island are mine.
Hm. A walking stone.
You smell of axe.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的刺不客气。
lines.en: Not too close. My thorns are rude.

lines.zh: 这一下连我的毛都没打乱。
lines.en: That blow did not even ruffle my fur.
My hide is thick; your hand will hurt first.

lines.zh: 我被激怒了，你最好退开。
lines.en: Now I am angry. You should step back.

lines.zh: 一只耳朵被打得贴住了头。
lines.en: One ear got pinned against my head.
My blood runs deep. Can you finish it?
I stepped back only to shift my weight.
The mushroom cap took part of that.
That numbed one of my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我不轻易发火，但会记仇。
lines.en: I rarely rage, but I do remember.
You messed up my fuzz.
Still standing. Don't gloat.
Easy. I'm old.
Another scar on my rings.
Don't touch. That part's new.
It hurts enough to burrow.
Pain, from root to leaf.
Lost a leaf. No matter.
My roots still hold.
It hurts. Only a little.
I'm splitting. Hear it?

lines.zh: 胡萝卜，你居然带了胡萝卜。
lines.en: A carrot. You actually brought a carrot.
Give it here and I promise not to hit you.
That smell makes my hind legs weak.
I smell it. Orange and crisp.

lines.zh: 咬一口，我就能站你这边。
lines.en: One bite and I am on your side.

lines.zh: 你把手举高些，我够不着。
lines.en: Hold it higher. I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 吃这个，我会安静一整天。
lines.en: Eating this will keep me calm all day.
I am not often this obedient.
Do not give half and take it back.

lines.zh: 我的力气都用在忍耐上了。
lines.en: All my strength is going into waiting.
That fruit fell at my feet.

lines.zh: 我不贪心，只要那片叶子。
lines.en: Not greedy. Just that leaf.
A little, and I'll remember you kindly.
Something sweet. Have I tasted that?

lines.zh: 我守着蘑菇岛，怪物别来。
lines.en: I guard the mushroom island; monsters stay out.
Is that for me? It is, isn't it?
Seeds are rattling in your pocket.
Every leaf of mine leans toward you.
I smell mushrooms on the wind.
Fragrant earth. Utterly unfair.
Running into me is like running into a wall.
I am too big to move aside.

lines.zh: 你被我的耳朵扫了一下。
lines.en: One of my ears brushed you.
I shift half my body out of the way.
That did not hurt you, did it?
My belly is rather springy.
You pushed in and I got nudged back.
We knocked a mushroom cap loose.

lines.zh: 我的爪子压到了你的脚背。
lines.en: My paw pressed on the top of your foot.
I try not to step on people.
Watch where you go, two-legs.
Careful. Thorns here.
You're rougher than any wind.
Ow! My bark!
Fine. Let's both step back.
These old bones can't take it.
Skip the apology. Just move.
Steady. Don't fall into me again.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我这身蘑菇就还手了。
lines.en: Bump me again and the mushroom body hits back.
You bent my root crooked.

lines.zh: 我不能有后代，这是天生的。
lines.en: I cannot have offspring. That is how I am made.

lines.zh: 想要一只像我这样的，得用孢子。
lines.en: To make one like me, you need spores.
My kind are too few to ever meet.

lines.zh: 我对着自己的影子坐着。
lines.en: I sit beside my own shadow.

lines.zh: 这片林子只有我一个守卫。
lines.en: I am the only guardian of this grove.
I tried once. Nothing happened.

lines.zh: 我把最大的蘑菇留给谁呢。
lines.en: Who will I leave the biggest mushroom to?
That question makes me a little sad.
The spores will carry on for me.
I sleep alone beneath a mushroom cap.
Your scent makes me unsteady.
After seeding, I'll tend them.
Every petal of mine is open.
This season allows one love only.
Let's tangle our roots together.
This flower is for you.

lines.zh: 你开花了吗，我等很久了。
lines.en: Have you bloomed? I've waited long.
Leave the pollen to the wind.
We'll grow into one grove.
I bloom slowly, but I last.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，捡了也没用。
lines.en: I have no pockets, so picking things up is pointless.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把那东西拨开。
lines.en: I push that thing aside with a paw.
Red mushrooms I simply eat.

lines.zh: 这块东西比蘑菇硬多了。
lines.en: This thing is far harder than a mushroom.
I picked it up, then put it down.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的都不属于我。
lines.en: Nothing on the ground belongs to me.
My paws are too thick to grip it.
You dropped it. You keep it.
I only collect caps and stems.
It looks tiny in my grip.
Someone dropped this. I'll keep it.
Let me find it a good spot.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛归我守，怪物别过来。
lines.en: I guard this mushroom isle. Stay back, monsters.
A stone. Rounded just right.
Don't watch. I'm hiding something.
Will this thing rot?
No pockets. Only soil.
Picked up means no take-backs.
This leaf is still useful.
Sniff first. Then stash it.

lines.zh: 那只僵尸进了我的林子。
lines.en: That zombie entered my grove.

lines.zh: 天黑之后，我认得该打谁。
lines.en: After dark, I know who deserves a hit.
I will protect this mushroom bed.
A shape is moving behind the tree.
My ears turn toward that sound.

lines.zh: 骷髅的骨头声太明显了。
lines.en: A skeleton's rattling is easy to hear.
It is getting close to my mushrooms.
I do not chase far. I strike what is near.

lines.zh: 你若是怪物，就站住别动。
lines.en: If you are a monster, stand still.
At night I am not easy to reason with.

lines.zh: 你的气味不是菌类，是猎物。
lines.en: You smell not of fungus but of prey.
Run. I don't chase fast.
Stand still. It'll be quicker.
Prey? You'll do today.
No one leaves this patch.
My branches know you.
The shadow falls. Now.
The soil is counting for you.
You. Today's nourishment.
On this mushroom isle, you are mine.
I flatten myself, ready to spring.
It still walks. I wait one more step.
My hind legs are drawn tight.
Close enough means one strike.
I move between it and the mushroom bed.

lines.zh: 它没看见我这副大身子。
lines.en: It has not seen this huge body.
I count the feet coming closer.

lines.zh: 再一步，就进我的范围了。
lines.en: One more step and it is in my reach.
I hold still, spores and all.
It turned. This is the moment.

lines.zh: 你往左躲，我的孢子也往左。
lines.en: Dodge left, and my spores follow left.
One step at a time.
Pant. I don't tire.
The tree is moving. See it?
No path ahead. Look back.
Branches have circled ahead.
Ten more steps won't help.
Fallen leaves mark your trail.
That sound. Your heartbeat?

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛的地面开始震了。
lines.en: The mushroom island ground has started to shake.
One swat sent it flying.

lines.zh: 我的前爪压下去，地都陷了。
lines.en: My front paw came down and the ground sank.
That blow should scatter its bones.

lines.zh: 我用整个身子把它撞开。
lines.en: I rammed it with my whole body.
It got stomped into the mushroom bed.
My bite can snap a mushroom stem.

lines.zh: 它还敢靠近，我再打一次。
lines.en: It dares come closer, so I strike again.

lines.zh: 我把土和孢子一起掀起来。
lines.en: I throw up soil and spores together.
That one was for the mushrooms.
After the hit I retreat under a cap.
You can't block a hundred rings.
Move. I'm falling your way.
My shadow hits you first.
Wood can hurt too.
A hundred years of practice.
I swing slow. And heavy.
Fall. Like a tree.
This one's for the forest.
My branches are no feather.
Take this branch!

lines.zh: 我从一朵巨大的菌伞下钻出来。
lines.en: I emerged from beneath a giant mushroom cap.

lines.zh: 第一眼看到的全是紫和红。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was purple and red.
I was already heavy at birth.

lines.zh: 孢子落在我身上，长成了绒毛。
lines.en: Spores settled on me and grew into fuzz.

lines.zh: 这片菌林从我脚下开始。
lines.en: This mushroom forest began at my feet.
I have no brothers or sisters.
When I opened my eyes, the sky was purple.

lines.zh: 我闻到的第一样东西是土。
lines.en: The first thing I smelled was soil.
My ears grew first.

lines.zh: 我学着用四条腿撑住身体。
lines.en: I learned to hold this body on four legs.

lines.zh: 那夜我第一次听见怪物的声音。
lines.en: That night I first heard a monster's sound.

lines.zh: 我生来就是要守这里的。
lines.en: I was born to guard this place.
My rings start today.
Sun first. Talk later.
I smell an axe already.
Right then. Let's grow.
Slept too long. Stiff all over.
Is it spring yet?
Is there enough sun here?
I'm awake. Is the grove?
Easy now. Find my footing.
The soil is calling my name.
I woke from the soil.
Something's moving over there.

lines.zh: 我怕火，绒毛一下就焦了。
lines.en: I fear fire; my fuzz scorches at once.
I'm burning. Hit me!

lines.zh: 我这么重，摔下去地都裂了。
lines.en: I am heavy; the ground cracked when I fell.
Fell from high. Dizzy.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，孢子全浮上来。
lines.en: I sank and all my spores floated up.
Too much water. Roots rotting.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻在菌床上。
lines.en: The blast flipped me onto the mushroom bed.
Soil's gone. My roots!

lines.zh: 箭插进我的厚皮，只进了一点。
lines.en: The arrow sank only a little into my thick hide.
Hit by an arrow. Unfair.

lines.zh: 魔法让我身上的孢子乱飞。
lines.en: Magic sent the spores on me scattering.
Wrong light. Too cold.

lines.zh: 我饿起来会啃光半片菌林。
lines.en: When hungry I could clear half the grove.
The soil's dry. Where's water?

lines.zh: 雷劈在我背上，绒毛全立起来。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and my fur stood up.
Charred, crown to root.

lines.zh: 这里连菌丝都长不出来。
lines.en: Not even mycelium grows here.
Empty. Nothing at all.
